action.objective: Verify e5g6 (Nxg6) as the strongest candidate to win material and open Black's king.
action.rationale: Broad search at depth 2 gave e5g6 exact score 302, best of all moves. It captures the g6 bishop (e5g6), and if h7xg6 then Qxg6+ wins back the piece with an attack; only e5g6 has an exact bound, others are upper (possibly worse). Verifying at depth 4 to confirm no tactical refutation.
